localChanges: Ten civilizations whose two colours were hard to read against each other now have better-matched ones, so the markings on their units and cities stand out: the Aztecs, Australians, Barbarians, Brazilians, Ethiopians, Incas, Indians, Japanese, Mongols and Sioux. The Mongols are now olive green with cream (closes #778).

log: The Australian colours were #1A7F4B and #FFCD00, which have too little contrast to read on each other: the new interface's city banners write a city's size in the second colour on the first. They are now #1A7F4B and #FFF6C2, the green they had, with cream, which read at 4.5:1 or better and keep the civilizations' first colours apart (civ-clone/web-renderer#778).

The build-on-push workflow, scripts and devDependencies match base-civilization-ethiopian's: pnpm on Node 22, prettier --check, a compile that fails on stale output, and mocha. yarn.lock goes, and registerCityNames.ts is formatted as prettier --check now requires (civ-clone/web-renderer#66).
